audit.what: The flagged row is a genuine hand-written HTML snippet to audit, with a per-task expected issue list. The rubric scores WCAG-criterion F1 against that list.
audit.evidence: __init__.py:694-716 navbar HTML prompt with answer issues 1.1.1/4.1.2/2.1.1/2.4.1/1.3.1 (lines 719-750); wcag_detection_score :1340-1363 computes recall/precision of `\d+\.\d+\.\d+` mentions vs expected criteria. Other components are keyword heuristics (fix_quality_score :1488-1525).
audit.user_impact: Scores are real but partly keyword-gameable (ARIA/semantic tag counts). Small dataset (10 rows).
